name: Ge Pamungkas
bio: Ge Pamungkas (born Genrifinadi Pamungkas on January 25, 1989, in Jakarta) is an Indonesian stand-up comedian, actor, and writer. He is famously known for winning the second season of Stand Up Comedy Indonesia (SUCI) on Kompas TV in 2012.

credits.title: Philosophy of the Porch
credits.overview: A dedicated young woman serving as her family's primary financial provider finds her matrimonial aspirations permanently derailed when she uncovers a debilitating secret: their ancestral home was pawned by her late father to finance her eldest brother's opulent wedding.

credits.overview: Dr. Sumy Hastry—a sharp, calm, and experienced forensic is intertwined with intuition and supernatural phenomena that are part of her long journey.

credits.title: GOAT Pandemonium Ge on all tempo
credits.overview: After his hit show "GOAT," Ge Pamungkas is back with fresh material — exploring love, marriage and the battle of the sexes in this comedy special.

credits.title: Jadi Tuh Barang
credits.overview: Bonar has just fallen out of love with Cantika and is trying to rise from his downturn with the help of his two friends, Awang and Wongso. They also received offers to become rain charmers to earn money.

credits.title: Only Your Name in My Prayers
credits.overview: Nala live a seemingly harmonious family. The father always prayed for his family to remain healthy and happy, both in this world and the hereafter. However, a figure from the father's past, whose matters remained unresolved, eventually caused a rift in their family life.
